description: This file defines the LanguageRequestSubscriber class, which subscribes to kernel request events in Drupal to initialize and override language settings based on the current request and user.

classes.name: LanguageRequestSubscriber
classes.description: Subscribes to kernel request events to initialize language settings based on the current request and user context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageRequestSubscriber with dependencies: language manager, negotiator, translation service, and current user.

methods.name: onKernelRequestLanguage
methods.description: Handles the kernel request event to set language overrides if the request is the main request.

methods.name: onContainerInitializeSubrequestFinished
methods.description: Handles the event when the container finishes initializing a subrequest, to set language overrides.

methods.name: setLanguageOverrides
methods.description: Sets language configurations and default language code based on the current language and user.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, with associated callback methods and priorities.
